title: Data Unlearning via Inverse Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36099v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-step matching models, including flow and diffusion models, produce high-quality outputs but incur substantial inference costs and may reproduce unwanted components of their training datasets. We introduce Inverse Distillation Unlearning (IDU), a unified framework that simultaneously distills a teacher multi-step matching model into an efficient one-step student generator and suppresses outputs corresponding to a designated training subset. We first formulate distillation as a min-max objective over a data distribution and then represent this distribution as a mixture of the forget-set and the generated distributions. This allows us to compare this mixture with the teacher's training distribution and recover only the retained data at the optimum. translated_title: 通过逆向蒸馏实现数据遗忘
translated_abstract: 多步匹配模型，包括流模型和扩散模型，能够产生高质量的输出，但会产生巨大的推理成本，并且可能重现其训练数据集中不需要的内容。我们提出了逆向蒸馏遗忘（Inverse Distillation Unlearning, IDU），这是一个统一的框架，能够在将教师多步匹配模型蒸馏为高效的单步学生生成器的同时，抑制与指定训练子集相对应的输出。我们首先将蒸馏表述为关于数据分布的极小极大目标，然后将该分布表示为遗忘集分布与生成分布的混合。这使得我们能够将该混合分布与教师的训练分布进行比较，并在最优解处仅恢复出保留的数据。我们的方法只需要一个预训练的全数据教师模型和来自遗忘集的数据，无需访问保留的训练样本、额外的特征提取器或分类器。大量实验……
tldr: 提出逆向蒸馏遗忘（IDU）统一框架，在将多步匹配模型蒸馏为高效单步生成器的同时实现对指定遗忘集数据的遗忘，且无需访问保留数据、额外特征提取器或分类器。
en_tdlr: Proposes Inverse Distillation Unlearning (IDU), a unified framework that simultaneously distills a multi-step matching model into an efficient one-step generator while unlearning a designated forget set, requiring no access to retained data, extra feature extractors, or classifiers.
